_comment: Modules under src/ that export symbols but have no production importer. Every entry must carry a reason: the checker only requires the key to exist, so the reason is what makes it reviewable. Delete an entry the moment the module gains an importer - the checker prints '! allowlist entry no longer matches an orphan' when it does. Keys starting with _ are documentation, not entries.
_schema: relative path -> reason it is still unreachable
src/lib/specQueue.ts: Verifies an OpenSpec change queue at OPENSPEC_CHANGES_DIR (default <root>/openspec/changes). This repo has no openspec/ directory, so wiring it into the loop would report 'no specs' forever. Kept because the env var makes it usable the moment OpenSpec is adopted, and it has a real test (tests/spec-queue.test.ts).
src/lib/recourseSdk.ts: A published SDK surface, advertised in README.md:83-84. It is for EXTERNAL consumers, so having no in-repo importer is correct by design; there is no CLI that uses it. Revisit if the README claim is withdrawn.
src/lib/v5/proofLadder.ts: SMT component verification. FIXED 2026-10-05: every encoder is now relational over QF_SLIA (input/output modeled, property negated) and verified against real cvc5 in tests/proofLadder.test.ts; unknown properties yield sat (downgrade). Still no production caller: verifyComponent needs EXPLICIT properties and the route must not invent them, and no production code composes v5 library components (the only compose() caller is searchLibrary itself). Wire when a caller with explicit properties exists.
src/lib/v5/sygus.ts: SyGuS-v2 candidate proposer for /v5/synthesize. FIXED 2026-10-05: differentialCheck now compares against reference outputs and returns the counterexample (never a vacuous true); the three identity-stub tsImplementations (app/ins/filtf) are real; propose() passes --check-synth-sol so cvc5 pre-filters its own stream. Covered by tests/sygusOracle.test.ts. Still no production caller for propose(): spawning cvc5 per request belongs in an offline/batch path, not in the /v5/synthesize request handler, which already verifies via the sandbox suite.
